shots.focal_element: The headset held in first-person POV over a coffee table, then the view through its lenses revealing a miniature fantasy castle on the table
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, normal tracking, small and centred over the footage; Meta's own sans is a low-confidence guess
shots.what_happens: First-person hands lift the headset toward the camera; the lenses fill the frame (a push through the eyepieces), then the view resolves into passthrough of the same table now topped with a mixed-reality castle, and the caption appears.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut POV footage of the headset moving to the lens, scale the lens interior to fill the frame to mask a cut to the AR-composited table plate, then fade in a centred bold sans caption once the new plate settles.

shots.focal_element: Kinetic caption 'With natural depth perception' tracked into a living-room battle scene of fantasy figurines and a glowing die, with the user in the headset behind
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the passthrough table frame, then a fast motion-blurred camera swoop down into the tabletop scene (the detector flagged a non-cut boundary)
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, lower/sentence case; words are placed in 3D space at different sizes and depths ('depth' largest), tracked to the scene and partially occluded by characters
shots.what_happens: The previous caption holds briefly, then the camera dives into the figurine battle; 'With natural depth perception' arrives as words scattered in 3D space that move with the camera and get occluded by figurines, before a spell effect clears the text and the shot ends on a wide of the user seated in the headset.
shots.build_rebuild: Camera-track the plate, place each caption word as a separate 3D text layer at a different z-depth and scale with figurine roto mattes for occlusion, then burst it away under a VFX flash before cutting to the wide.

shots.focal_element: User on a sofa adjusting the headset, with a large centred caption
on_screen_text: Transform your home into a virtual
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, normal tracking, large centred line over footage; second line types on word by word
shots.what_happens: Wide of the user settling the headset on; the headline 'Transform your home' sits centred, then at the end of the shot it shrinks and a second line starts building in ('into a virtual') as the cut to a close-up lands.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centred bold sans headline over the wide plate, then on the last frames scale it down and start a per-word reveal of the second line so the text animation straddles the hard cut.

shots.focal_element: Shallow-depth-of-field close-up of the smiling user without the headset, behind a two-line centred caption
on_screen_text: Transform your home into a virtual playground
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, normal tracking, two centred lines with tight leading
shots.what_happens: Close-up of the user smiling in backlit warm light while the completed two-line headline holds centred over the face.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the completed two-line centred caption static over a shallow-focus close-up plate for about 1.3 s, with no further text motion.

shots.focal_element: CG renders of the new Touch controllers: macro thumbstick close-up, then a pair of controllers floating on a soft gradient
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, centred; first line blurs/focuses in, second line types on character by character ('With Tru' then 'With TruTouch haptics')
shots.what_happens: A slow macro move across the controller face and thumbstick with 'Meet our redesigned controllers' racking into focus; it cuts within the shot to both controllers rotating in space on a pastel gradient while 'With TruTouch haptics' types on, and the last frame is already the next live-action plate.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a macro dolly over the controller face with depth-of-field, blur-in a centred caption, then swap to a slow rotating pair of controllers on a soft gradient and type the second caption on per character.

shots.focal_element: Mid-shot of a person in a denim shirt gripping the controllers, with the caption's last word highlighted
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif, sentence case, centred single line; the final word 'feel' shifts to an accent colour with a brief shake/doubling as if vibrating
shots.what_happens: The user's hands squeeze the controllers in shallow focus while 'For experiences you can feel' holds centred; 'feel' jitters and changes to an accent colour to mimic a haptic pulse.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centred sans caption over the hand plate and, near the end, apply a few-frame position jitter plus an accent colour shift to the last word to simulate a haptic buzz.
